_comment: ntrip-monitord configuration. Copy to /etc/ntrip-monitord/monitord.json and edit. output_dir must match the Munin plugin's env.statedir (default /var/lib/ntrip-monitor).
_comment_report: report_window_s: length of the tier-2 rolling window in seconds. The published <mountpoint>.report.json covers between one and two of these. Minimum 600 -- the shortest window the report will judge at all -- and 3600 by default.
